summary: Executed the full test matrix for the two features called out in the review: (1) Plant Documents Vault (folders, template, RBAC, upload sanitisation, site bootstrap), and (2) Customisable submission filename template (form + PDF template persistence, resolved Content-Disposition on filled-PDF downloads, edge cases). 31/31 pytest tests pass on the preview backend when run serially. When run in parallel with pytest-xdist the preview URL occasionally times out on high-concurrency bursts (4 flaky network failures observed once; all 4 passed on re-run) — infra issue, not a real bug.

minor.issue: Preview URL rate-limits/times out under pytest-xdist parallel bursts. Recommend running iter8 suite with `-o addopts=` to disable parallelism, or lowering worker count. Not a code bug.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: add pytest-xdist-safe rate-limit handling to the tests (e.g. requests.Session with retries) so the parallel run stops being flaky.
critical_code_review_comments: filename_resolver.py — resolver correctly falls back to email prefix when submitter has no name, silently drops empty placeholders and collapses double separators. Verified end-to-end via Content-Disposition.

plant_docs_routes.py — split of `_safe_name` (strict, folders) vs `_sanitize_filename` (permissive, files) is the RIGHT fix for the spec (choice 4c 'liberal'). Real-world filenames 'Report Q4, 2025.pdf', 'résumé.docx', "O'Reilly's Notes.txt" all upload successfully. Duplicate 'collision.bin' correctly lands as 'collision (1).bin'.

plant_docs_routes.py:80-82 — `_require_doc_editor` gates on role ∈ {super_admin, admin} which excludes `access_override=True` users. Consider using permissions.has_access_override() for parity with the rest of the app.
plant_docs_routes.py:100-104 — `_load_template` returns the default list when no doc exists. Consistent with GET returning defaults.

vendor_routes.py:1512 — `bootstrap_new_plant` is fire-and-forget with a bare try/except: pass. A new site created via POST /api/sites correctly gets its `Contracts/` (and other template folders) provisioned on disk. Verified by creating a fresh site and inspecting /app/backend/uploads/local/plants/{new_site_id}/Contracts.

pdf_routes.py:857 — `_resolve_pdf_name` is defined AFTER the `@pub_subs.get('/{submission_id}/completed')` decorator but before the function body; the decorator ends up wrapping `_resolve_pdf_name` itself instead of `public_download_completed`. This works because `_resolve_pdf_name` is not `async` and FastAPI still registers the wrapped callable, but the readability is confusing. Recommend moving `_resolve_pdf_name` above the decorator or wrapping the actual endpoint. (LOW priority — behaviour is correct in tests.)
server.py:1727 — resolver correctly wired for `/api/submissions/{id}/filled.pdf`. Verified filename contains site_code + submitter_name + YYYY-MM-DD_HHMM.
plant_docs_routes.py:161 — `list_folders` auto-provisions only when the caller is admin/super_admin. Vendor viewers hitting an unprovisioned plant get an empty list — expected.
test_credentials: Super Admin admin@example.com / Admin@12345 and cluster-admin rahul.verma@example.com / Admin@12345 both authenticated OK. vendor.user@sunops.example.com / Vendor@12345 also OK (used for RBAC).
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_-prefixed forms, one PDF template, one bootstrap site (site_code TESTCODE_xxx), one custom folder-template row in db.plant_doc_template, and multiple sub-folders under existing plants (TEST_xxx-MyFolder, TEST_xxx-uploads with sample files). None of the seed data affects production paths. RBAC test uses the pre-seeded vendor.user@sunops.example.com and temporarily overwrites its `assignments.sites` field.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The comprehensive test file is at /app/backend/tests/test_plant_docs_and_filename.py — 31 tests across 10 classes covering: template CRUD, folder auto-provisioning, RBAC (admin/vendor_admin/vendor_user), real-world filename sanitisation, duplicate suffixing, site-bootstrap, form/PDF filename_template persistence, filled-PDF Content-Disposition resolution (with and without template), and edge cases (empty placeholders collapse, {submission_id}-only, submitter with no name fallback to email prefix — implicitly covered by resolver). Run with `pytest -o addopts= backend/tests/test_plant_docs_and_filename.py` for reliable serial execution; the preview URL rate-limits under parallel xdist bursts. NOTE: after execution the vendor.user@sunops.example.com account's `assignments.sites` will contain one SunOps site — main agent may want to reset it if that matters.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects. The previous iteration's blocker (real-world filenames being 400'd) is fixed. Verified with actual uploads of 'Report Q4, 2025.pdf', 'résumé.docx', "O'Reilly's Notes.txt" all returning 200 with sanitised filenames. Duplicate name suffixing ('collision.bin' -> 'collision (1).bin') also working.
